sections.Description:
The game will immerse players in campy fun and heart-pounding action as the crime fighting Dynamic Duo comes to the aid of the Gotham City Police.

Throughout the game, Batman and Robin work to deduce clues and discover super villain plots in an effort to thwart evil plans and capture bad guys. Players are guided through the game by the voices of none other than the original Batman and Robin, Adam West and Burt Ward.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Dynamic rotating Action Turntable Mini Playfield: Introducing the dynamic rotating Action Turntable Mini Playfield which presents the player with numerous alternating shots and targets; the interactive "Villain Vision TV Set" and more.
- Shoot the interactive Crane: Batman 66 features a modern version of one of the most popular toys in the history of modern pinball, the interactive crane from Batman The Dark Knight.
- Audio and Video straight from the Show!: Featuring action video footage from the iconic TV series blended with all new animations and display effects on the LCD screen and integrated into game play events with speech call outs by Adam West (Batman) and Burt Ward (Robin).
sections.Editions:
Premium:

- Bat Gadget Selector illuminated button on front molding with collectable card holder.
- Speech calls by Adam West (Batman) and Burt Ward (Robin).

Limited Edition:

Super Limited Edition:
